source: User supplied colleague proposal in промпт.txt; proposals are design input, not authority to change metric or permissions
baseline: Exact CP1B archive52627ac5b9da5ee47d8d40951f84edf9b9dede28cca4b4f90504be6bb4e672b8; strongest V11/V16 and CP1/B retained

first_catalog_scope.classification: Deferred: existing multiclass_strategy remains sole setting; no softmax/OVA profile readiness claim
first_catalog_scope.runtime_readiness: Not ready until typed path and actual model-parameter contracts pass

experiments.purpose: Verify typed profile survives normalization/effective parameters/signature and reaches actual fitted LightGBM objective/alpha; preserve legacy behavior and primary stopping metric
experiments.scope: Technical contracts only, no public quality score
required: legacy planner capability packet unchanged without opt-in

experiments.hypothesis: At fixed features, weights, target transform, seeds and early-stopping metric, another supported training loss may improve original-scale RMSE. This does not presume large residuals are erroneous outliers.
experiments.unit: Protected LightGBM SINGLE regression recipe, fixed loss only; no whole-agent or skill gain claim
experiments.cuts: Same three immutable forward NPZ cuts0/1/2 as METH01/METH02; never regenerate or optimize cuts
experiments.control: Explicit lgbm_l2_v1 with saved exact legacy SINGLE control as additional parity reference
experiments.required_before_launch: Actual LOSS00 contracts/release/source readiness, source publication and immutable source/job/input/split/evaluator pins, all previous actual exits and fresh known ownership/preparer union; root freezes exact execution protocol
experiments.quality: Independently recompute original-scale RMSE from pristine labels and saved predictions on every cut. Each candidate must strictly improve all three cuts vs unchanged matched L2. Failures/null/timeout remain in the outcome.
experiments.LLM_feedback: No outer results fed to the loss proposer. This is a preregistered fixed non-LLM profile screen.

experiments.purpose: Tune only a promising fixed profile versus L2 under equal internal-HPO and real common budgets; compare realized trials and startup/guided counts
experiments.depends_on: LOSS01 measured quality/cost and certified nested inner partitions

experiments.purpose: Measure the usefulness of the skill: A current agent, B bounded non-LLM profile enumeration, C Qwen choice with loss-selection
experiments.same_inputs: Trusted fitting-only inner diagnostics with provenance and evidence IDs; no external labels/metrics or old full-train target summary; same profile catalog and constraints
experiments.proposal_contract: decision/control_id/loss_profile_id/evidence_refs/hypothesis, or skip with reason; no arbitrary Python/metric/split authority
experiments.fairness: Equal real common budgets including builder I/O, API/retries, all fits, selection, refit/CSV/audit. Count actual model fits and usage; proposal validity is not an ML win.

clock_assignment: Each future execution assigns its absolute common deadline exactly once, only after readiness; no existing campaign is reopened or its clock reset
history: Keep initial METH02 FAIL and every closed method result; this file adds new loss hypotheses, not duplicate method screens
